title: Mississippi Sound this week: November 13, 2026
headline: The Pearl, Pascagoula, Wolf and Biloxi rivers are running low, so the Sound is saltier than usual for mid-November. All 21 monitored beaches are clear for swimming.
lines: The Pascagoula River at Merrill is at its second-lowest mid-November flow since 1998. Only 2016 was lower.
Point Cadet (Back Bay) has its third-saltiest mid-November water since 2001. Only 2023 and 2008 were saltier.
Round Island is saltier than usual for mid-November (32.3 ppt vs. a typical 25.6 ppt).
Rivers over the last 60 days look most like 2016, 2010 and 2023 (background, not a forecast).
